readingUncertainties: The 27/09 MAD-ARN and ARN-MAD sectors are printed as 3h55 block, which is long for that pair but is internally consistent with the STD/STA local times and with the 106h20 header block total, so it has been taken at face value.
Nightstop stations are inferred from where each outbound duty ends (JFK, BOS, DXB, ORD); the roster does not print hotel or layover lines. The intervening days are printed OFF.
